title: Pinzón from Cape Santo Agostinho to the Amazon, 1500
summary: Pinzón left Palos with four caravels in November 1499 and, by the usual account, sighted the coast of Brazil at Cape Santo Agostinho on 26 January 1500, some three months before Cabral. He followed the coast north and west, entered the mouth of the Amazon, and reached the Gulf of Paria. He is credited with the first European landfall in Brazil, though Cabral's, which is better recorded, took Brazil for Portugal.
